inspectedText: Institutional article describes37 ichthyosaur skeletons and an investigation using strata, chemistry and population ages. Embryonic/newborn remains plus adults without juveniles support a proposed birth-site explanation rather than one catastrophe; the article notes no smoking gun. It cannot establish how each animal died or turn a plausible nursery reconstruction into observed behavior. Original research body not inspected.
sourceQualityRationale: Smithsonian account connected to the researchers, useful preliminary lead and interpretation limits; not the original paper.
